KUBERAN COMPASS

Wilderness, Sighting & Celestial Navigation • Privacy & Data Safety Disclosure

🛡️ Zero-Telemetry Commitment

Your privacy and safety in the outdoors are paramount. Kuberan Compass (Package: com.kuberansilks.compass), developed and published by Kuberan Silks, is engineered from the ground up as a strict zero-telemetry, offline-first application.

100% On-Device Zero Remote Tracking No Third-Party SDKs

We do not collect, store, sell, harvest, or transmit your personal identity, device identifiers, location history, camera feeds, or navigation tracks to any remote server or third-party advertising network.

🧭 Hardware Sensors & Motion Telemetry

The application requires access to device motion and hardware geomagnetic sensors to deliver precision navigation capabilities:

  • Geomagnetic Sensor (Magnetometer): Measures the Earth's natural magnetic field vector to calculate azimuthal heading relative to Magnetic North.
  • Accelerometer & Gyroscope: Reads device pitch and roll angles to orient the dual-axis inclinometer bubble level and compensate for hand-held tilt.

Data Processing: All sensor samples are processed in real-time inside volatile device memory using a decoupled 60fps/120fps requestAnimationFrame pipeline. Sensor data is never logged to disk or transmitted outside your physical smartphone.

📷 Camera Usage (Augmented Reality HUD)

The app requests camera permissions (NSCameraUsageDescription on iOS and android.permission.CAMERA on Android) solely for the live Augmented Reality (AR) Sighting Reticle HUD.

  • The camera feed renders a real-time optical horizon through the phone's rear lens so you can sight distant terrain landmarks against heading telemetry.
  • Zero Remote Transmission: Optical frames are processed strictly in local device GPU canvas memory. No photographs or video streams are ever uploaded, recorded, or transmitted.
  • Camera snapshots captured via the AR snapshot button are saved directly to your device's local photo gallery via HTML5 Download and are never accessed by Kuberan Silks.

📍 Location Data (GPS & Waypoint Memory)

When permitted (NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription / ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION), location coordinates are used exclusively for:

  • Magnetic Declination: Calculating the angular difference between True Geographic North and Magnetic North using on-device World Magnetic Model formulas.
  • Celestial Ephemeris & Sundial: Calculating real-time solar elevation, solar noon, sunset/sunrise azimuth, lunar phase, and virtual sundial gnomon shadows.
  • Offline Waypoints & GPX Trail Tracker: Recording coordinate breadcrumbs along your hiking route and computing Great-Circle distance and forward bearings.

Storage: All waypoints and GPX trails are stored exclusively in your device's local browser storage (LocalStorage / IndexedDB). If you uninstall the app or clear browser data, this data is completely erased.

⚠️ Statutory Wilderness Disclaimer

Electronic smartphone compasses and GPS receivers are auxiliary navigation aids subject to battery depletion, magnetic anomalies, and satellite geometry degradation. Never rely solely on any smartphone application for life-critical wilderness survival. Always carry a certified physical lensatic magnetic compass, topographical paper map, and emergency beacon when venturing into backcountry or maritime environments.
